name: IndieMade
summary: Independent online store builder for makers and small sellers, with two-way Etsy sync, unlimited products and no platform transaction fees.
best_for: makers and small sellers who want their own store, with two-way Etsy sync, and no platform transaction fees
skip_if: you need a published price before you start, you want a marketplace that brings you buyers, or you sell outside US dollars and need a currency switch
honest_knock: The pricing page no longer shows plan prices, so you only see the cost at signup. Help articles disagree about whether the AI integration is in Plus only, and we did not check how cancellation works inside the dashboard.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month and Plus is $25 a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-25 on indiemade.com/plans-pricing) IndieMade lists two plans, Essential and Plus, and every plan starts with a 30-day free trial that needs no credit card. Essential costs $15 a month, or $12 a month billed annually. Plus costs $25 a month, or $20 a month billed annually. The page says IndieMade adds no listing fee and no transaction fee on any plan, and that you take payments through your own Stripe, Square or PayPal account, whose processing fees are separate. Hosting is included and every plan supports a custom domain. Unlimited products are included on every plan. The terms state prices in US dollars.

source_quotes.quote: Plus Everything in Essential, and more $25 / month $20/mo billed annually
Essential The complete store $15 / month $12/mo billed annually
30-day free trial. No credit card required.

compare_with.name: Shopify
compare_with.why: Shopify is covered in our directory only through its apps, so we have no direct comparison. Compare the signup price with Shopify and Big Cartel, and add the payment provider fees to both

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested IndieMade in the 30-day trial of a store we created. A made-up product added by hand was on its own visitor page with price and Add to Cart in about a minute. The store cannot sell yet: no payment provider is connected and store e-mail is off during the trial. Plan & Billing shows Essential at $15 a month and Plus at $25 a month, the same as the public page; no plan was selected and Etsy was not connected. Account and start: we created the account and the test store before the session; sign-up was not repeated. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026; the core action started at 09:31 CET. The dashboard was in English. The dossier name is IndieMade and the review is on MSS (mss/indiemade-review.html). The empty catalog offered three routes: Connect your Etsy shop, Add a product by hand (name, price, a photo and stock count, about a minute) and Upload a CSV. A banner said that while the store is on a free trial, e-mail from the store to customers and the public is turned off; the sidebar said 30 days left on the free trial. Core action, a first product by hand: Add product has fields for title, description, categories, tags, price in USD, SKU, stock, options, flag, image, digital downloads, SEO and Published. A made-up product, Test Ceramic Mug, with a short description, a price of 12.50 and a plain test image made for the test, was saved with Published on by default. The visitor page of the product opened at once with The product has been successfully saved, $12.50, Add to Cart and the image, within about 1 minute and 6 to 8 actions, with no wait. The dashboard product list shows it at $12.50. The store is not ready for real sales: no payment provider is connected and store e-mail is off during the trial. Etsy Connect says You are currently not connected to Etsy and promises import, saving to Etsy, stock updates on sale and automatic updates of Etsy products; it was not connected, and adding a product by hand did not need it. Plans: In Plan & Billing: Essential, The complete store, $15.00 USD a month, and Plus $25.00 USD a month, both with unlimited products; the public page indiemade.com/plans-pricing lists $12 and $20 a month on yearly billing and says 30-day free trial. No credit card required. Essential includes variations, bulk editing, Stripe, PayPal and Square, a two-way Etsy sync, Facebook, Instagram, Printify, Google Shopping, a custom domain and an MCP AI server; Plus adds product filters, product videos, private listings, made to order and advanced analytics. Checkout: Plan & Billing shows Payment method, No payment method on file, with Add payment method, and Select Essential and Select Plus; none was clicked, so no payment page, card field, tax or total was seen. Payment history: No payments yet. Cancelling: the pricing FAQ says you can cancel anytime with no contracts and no cancellation fees; in the dashboard no cancel button was seen during the trial, because there is no subscription and no card. A cancel route after payment was not tested. Not tested: the Etsy sync, payment providers, taking the store live for real sales, made to order, a second and third product, and checking out as a visitor. Clean up: the test product and the store stay. The own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: During the trial the store sends no e-mail to customers, so order mails cannot be tried before you pay. A product goes live on its public page as soon as you save it, because Published is on by default.
